title: JSONL logger: gate by mode — only log actionable commands
description:
Only append to command_history.jsonl in specific circumstances.

INCLUDE:
- A command in command mode
- A command in mixed mode
- A noise in command mode
- A noise in mixed mode
- A command targeting mode:all

EXCLUDE:
- Commands that do not match (failed recognition)
- Any phrase during sleep mode
- Anything rejected by the system

Implementation: In log_command(), check scope.get(mode) before writing. Skip if only sleep mode active. Parrot path (log_parrot_command) already only fires from repeater which requires command/dictation mode via ctx.matches.

title: Migrate command logging to analyze_phrase architecture
description:
Port Andreas's on_phrase/analyze_phrase pattern to capture raw spoken words instead of processed captures. Current command_logger ignores the phrase_info parameter and calls actions.core.last_phrase() which returns processed cursorless objects instead of raw words like 'take line sit'.

Scope:
1. Reorganize on_phrase hooks into dedicated directory (core/on_phrase/) consolidating: command_logger, command_history display, subtitles/on_phrase, then_mimic post:phrase hooks
2. Port analyze_phrase module (types.py, analyze_phrase.py, calc_command_actions.py) to extract raw phrase words from phrase_info['phrase'] and per-command word mapping via capture._unmapped
3. Rewrite command_logger to use AnalyzedPhrase — log actual spoken words, per-command breakdown, action explanations
4. Update JSONL schema (v2.0) with raw phrase text, per-command entries, capture mappings
5. Keep backward compat in MCP command-history.ts reader

Reference: https://github.com/AndreasArvidsson/andreas-talon/tree/main/core/on_phrase

title: Build comprehensive Talon testing harness for agent development
description:
Build a robust testing infrastructure so agents can confidently develop and validate Talon plugins without needing Talon running.

## Problem
Talon has a custom Python runtime (built in Rust) with its own module system, action registry, context matching, captures, tags, settings, canvas/UI, and noise detection. Agents writing Talon code without understanding these internals produce code that looks correct but crashes at runtime. There's no way for agents to verify their work.

## Existing Testing Infrastructure
1. Community talon (trillium_talon) has basic stubs at test/stubs/talon/:
   - Module, Context, Actions, App, Settings, UI, ImgUI, Resource, Registry stubs
   - Some pytest tests for formatters, dictation, spoken forms
   - pyproject.toml configures pytest pythonpath

2. Mouse-clock (~/.talon/user/trillium/mouse-clock/) has its own .tests/ with:
   - conftest.py (path setup, screen_rect/center fixtures)
   - Tests for animation, config, geometry, voice_parsing, mouse_clock core
   - Runs via pytest

## What's Missing
- Canvas/drawing API stubs (skia bindings — critical for visual plugins)
- Noise/parrot API stubs
- Settings API that actually reads .talon setting files
- Context matching simulation (platform, app, tag, mode contexts)
- Action dependency resolution (understanding which actions exist)
- .talon file parser/validator (syntax checking voice commands)
- Integration test framework (simulate voice command → action chain)
- Documentation of Talon runtime behavior for agent consumption (AGENTS.md)

## Deliverables
1. Comprehensive talon stub library (expanding community stubs)
2. pytest fixtures for common Talon patterns (canvas, settings, contexts)
3. .talon file linter/validator
4. AGENTS.md documenting Talon's runtime model for AI agents
5. Example test patterns for each plugin type (voice commands, canvas overlays, parrot handlers)

## Location
Reusable across all Talon plugins:
- ~/.talon/user/trillium/mouse-clock/ (standalone project)
- ~/.talon/user/trillium_talon/trillium/ (plugins in the community fork)
- Any future Talon plugin projects
notes: Design: Expanding test/stubs/talon/ with sub-modules for canvas, skia, screen, ui, types, cron, clip, ctrl, noise/parrot, debug, scripting, fs. Adding conftest.py with fixtures. Updating AGENTS.md testing docs. Key insight: existing ui=UI() instance conflicts with from talon.ui import Rect — converting to proper sub-modules.
close_reason: Merged to main (bf737670). 67/67 tests passing. Comprehensive Talon testing harness delivered.
